name: 반짝이는 가루 교실
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly glitter-magic classroom, centered symmetrical framing on a tall hourglass slowly pouring shimmering dust, a shelf of matching glass jars lined up behind it; open stone floor foreground, sparkling motes catch teal moonlight and warm amber lamplight together, richly detailed glass and timber shelving, layered depth, polished fantasy concept art, the entire scene shimmering with cinematic magical dust.
